name: protein-human-mouse-struct-collector
description: Collect all human and mouse UniProt entries, PDB experimental structures, and AlphaFold predicted structures for any protein of interest. Downloads PDB and AlphaFold CIF files (with species-aware naming), fetches full-field JSON metadata from RCSB PDB Data API and AlphaFold EBI API, generates two Excel files (UniProt-only and comprehensive UniProt+PDB+AlphaFold), produces a detailed Markdown report plus a reproducible Jupyter notebook, and generates AlphaFold3 input JSON files for every sequence source (PDB experimental, AlphaFold predicted, and UniProt) paired with any user-specified ligand. Use this skill whenever someone asks to collect, download, or summarize structural data for a protein across human and mouse, or to generate AF3 input JSON files for all available sequences of a protein with a ligand.
